# What will product analytics cost at your event volume, and who is cheapest?

> Enter your monthly event volume and see what PostHog, Mixpanel, Plausible, Fathom and Umami Cloud charge, the 12-month spend under your growth rate, and the volume where the cheapest provider changes. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
